notes.title: Четыре девушки и страшная корпорация. Кого выбрать китайскому солдату? Обзор Lost in Darklight
notes.content: Мы уже давно не обращались к странному жанру FMV-игр — выходят они не очень часто, да и не всегда хочется тратить на них время. Однако на фоне азиатского бума и импортозамещения стало интересно познакомиться с новым китайским приключением Lost in Darklight.

notes.title: "Lost in Darklight" Officially Released on Steam Today!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! "Lost in Darklight" is now officially available on the Steam platform today. Thank you all for your patience and support!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43977442/eb818ca0482e83eea18eae7785f20863c47530cf.png[/img]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2251020/_Lost_in_Darklight/]Click here to visit the "Lost in Darklight" Steam store page >>>>[/url]

Featuring full live-action performances, multiple branching storylines, and immersive investigative puzzles.
While deep in a maze of mysteries and walking toward the light, are you going to let your desire expand under the shadow, or are you going to unravel the mysteries and face the challenges?
If everything were to return to the beginning, how would you choose?
This time, their destiny will be written by you!

notes.title: "Lost in Darklight" Developer's Note
notes.content:
Hello everyone, this is the team of "Lost in Darklight". "Love of Replica" has been hotly broadcasted on Sohu Video! As an interactive film of the same worldview and original team, we naturally come to celebrate with it! Otherwise it would be presumptuous to call it a sister piece! 

During the filming of "Love of Replica", we had such an idea: what kind of story would happen if the audience held the script of the male lead and chose the direction of the plot? So after the series was finished, we started again from the perspective of the main character and created "Lost in Darklight", a sister piece of "Love of Replica".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43977442/2348dc578d128e9ba675217e94aad91bfec13643.png[/img]

Besides the different perspective from "Love of Replica", the theme we focused on during the creation of "Lost in Darklight" has also undergone some changes. As a result, the relationships and identities between some of the characters are more or less different from those in the original series. This is also to avoid any confusion between the audience and players, and you can think of it as a story that happened in another parallel world if everything went back to the beginning.

Choosing the interactive film gameplay, we hope to ensure a smooth plot while allowing everyone to have a more immersive experience and enjoy "Lost in Darklight" like watching a short web series.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43977442/489e6390c8e362aa741beaed2201fc897d48e37d.png[/img]

To be honest, creating a new story based on the background of "Love of Replica" is a challenging task. All members of our team had to explore and experiment during the creative process, and there were many situations where we made assumptions. Fortunately, we were able to discover major problems in time and make changes. After continuous optimization and adjustment, "Lost in Darklight" has finally been polished to the version that is about to meet you.

We hope that everyone can feel the themes of redemption, choice, family, friendship and love in "Lost in Darklight". The seeds of sin are sprouting in Lancheng, and we wish you a smooth journey home!

We would be honored if you enjoy "Lost in Darklight"!
